name: Alpha Texturing (Billboarding)
definition: Using RGBA texture maps to render complex geometry (like trees) as simple primitives (rectangles), where alpha=1 represents solid parts (leaves/branches) and alpha=0 represents transparent gaps.
summary: Alpha Texturing renders complex geometry as simple 2D primitives textured with RGBA maps, using the alpha channel to define visibility and replace explicit 3D polygonal modeling.
